dict.string: ntakker records the microphone alongside system audio. Audio is written only to the file path you choose. Nothing is sent over the network.

ntakker uses Apple Speech Recognition to transcribe captured audio. When the on-device speech model for your chosen locale is unavailable, audio is sent to Apple's servers for processing (per Apple's Speech Recognition privacy policy).
ntakker uses the Screen Recording permission to capture system audio (the audio output of all running applications) via ScreenCaptureKit. No video frames are saved; only audio is recorded.
